mapper.sql: select id, member_id, source_url, cutout_url, cutout_box, title, category, caption, card_style, origin_type, origin_id, create_time, update_time, gen_status, frames_prefix, frame_count from player_object_card
mapper.insert: insert into player_object_card (member_id, source_url, cutout_url, cutout_box, title, category, caption, card_style, origin_type, origin_id, create_time, update_time, gen_status, frames_prefix, frame_count) values (#{memberId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{cutoutUrl}, #{cutoutBox}, #{title}, #{category}, #{caption}, #{cardStyle}, #{originType}, #{originId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{genStatus}, #{framesPrefix}, #{frameCount}) on duplicate key update source_url = values(source_url), cutout_url = values(cutout_url), cutout_box = values(cutout_box), title = values(title), category = values(category), caption = values(caption), card_style = values(card_style), update_time = values(update_time), gen_status = values(gen_status), frames_prefix = values(frames_prefix), frame_count = values(frame_count), model_url = null, gen_task_id = null, gen_provider = null, gen_error = null, gen_queued_at = null
mapper.select: select c.id, c.member_id, c.source_url, c.cutout_url, c.cutout_box, c.title, c.category, c.caption, c.card_style, c.origin_type, c.origin_id, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.gen_status, c.frames_prefix, c.frame_count, nullif(concat_ws(' · ', t.name, n.name), '') as place from player_object_card c left join cms_topic_node n on c.origin_type = 'PLAY' and n.id = c.origin_id left join cms_topic t on t.id = n.topic_id where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.category = #{category} order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
